tasks.title: App.Core drop-landing resolver: FloorDropIndicator.Locate, FloorDropLanding, FloorReorderDrop.TryReadDraggedFloorId
acceptance: C1-1 (new; neither file exists at 12ef199). `src/DungeonMaster.App.Core/Editor/FloorDropLanding.cs` declares exactly the record struct `FloorDropLanding` and `src/DungeonMaster.App.Core/Editor/FloorDropIndicator.cs` declares exactly the static class `FloorDropIndicator`, both in namespace `DungeonMaster.App.Core.Editor`, with the members, types and nullability contract C1 section 2 declares; `HasLanding` is a computed property, not a stored field (frontend discipline 'Derived values are computed'; dotnet-format.md section 2, one type per file). Evidence: the diff.

C1-2 (new). `FloorDropIndicator.Locate` implements the eight rows of contract C1 section 2.1's table, and `FloorDropIndicatorTests` holds at least one test per row whose name states the row's condition and outcome (test discipline, Naming). Evidence: the diff, and the filtered test run in C1-10. The test for the row 'resolved band t is not a FloorListBandKind.FloorCard' (Gate 2 decision D2) builds that band's kind as `(FloorListBandKind)int.MaxValue`, and no file this task writes names `TransientDropTarget`: `grep -c TransientDropTarget <each owned file>` prints 0 for every file, so T2's deletion of that member (C2-19) needs no change to this task's files.

C1-3 (new). One test per `LineY` case of contract C1 section 2.1 (gap 0, gap == bands.Count, interior gap) uses bands whose seam is non-zero (e.g. 54-DIU cards at a 58-DIU pitch), so the interior expected value differs from both neighbours' edges. Evidence: the diff.

C1-4 (new). An agreement test over 11 bands at a 58-DIU pitch and 54-DIU height, for every `draggedIndex` 0..10 and every integer y from -10 to 648 inclusive, asserts: `Locate(...).HasLanding` is true exactly when `FloorReorderNearest.Resolve(bands, y).Owner != FloorDropOwner.None` and its `BandIndex != draggedIndex`; and when it is true, `TargetIndex == Resolve(bands, y).BandIndex`. This is the one-owner rule of contract C1 section 2.1. Evidence: the diff.

C1-5 (new). A domain cross-check test builds a real `Dungeon` with 5 floors and, for each of the 20 ordered pairs (d, t) with d != t, calls `Dungeon.ReorderFloor(<floor at index d>.Id, t + 1)` and asserts that the dragged floor's 0-based position in Number order equals `GapIndex` when `GapIndex <= d`, else `GapIndex - 1`, where `GapIndex` comes from `Locate` for a y inside band t with `draggedIndex = d`. This proves the line marks where the reorder actually puts the floor (contract C1 section 2.1, 'Why the gap is the true landing position'). Evidence: the diff.

C1-6 (new). `FloorReorderDrop.TryReadDraggedFloorId` exists with contract C1 section 2.2's signature, and five tests cover its five cases: null payload, missing `FloorIdKey`, non-string value, unparsable string (each false with `Guid.Empty`) and a valid D-format string (true, with the id). Evidence: the diff.

C1-7 (refactor; at 12ef199 the parse lives in `Decide`: the key lookup at `FloorReorderDrop.cs:93` and `Guid.TryParse` at `:98`). After the change `Decide`'s body contains no `Guid.TryParse` and no `FloorIdKey` lookup and obtains the dragged id only through `TryReadDraggedFloorId`; `grep -n 'Guid.TryParse' src/DungeonMaster.App.Core/Editor/FloorReorderDrop.cs | grep -v '///'` prints exactly 1 line (Gate 2 decision D3: documentation lines are not counted), and that line lies inside `TryReadDraggedFloorId`. Evidence: the diff and the command.

C1-8 (preserved, newly tested). `Decide`'s five rows are unchanged: the diff of `src/DungeonMaster.Tests/AppCore/FloorReorderDropTests.cs` removes or alters no existing line (additions only), and the seven pre-existing test methods (`grep -c -E '^[[:space:]]*\[(Fact|Theory)' src/DungeonMaster.Tests/AppCore/FloorReorderDropTests.cs` prints 7 at 12ef199) pass in the run of C1-10; the C1-6 tests are the new instrument for the shared parser.

C1-9 (demonstrated discrimination; three injections, each at ONE named site and reverted, with the revert verified before any wider command runs). (a) In `Locate`, swap the GapIndex expressions of the two direction rows: the C1-5 test must fail. (b) Delete the `t == draggedIndex` -> None row: a C1-2 self row test and the C1-4 agreement test must fail. (c) In `TryReadDraggedFloorId`, accept a non-string value through `ToString()`: the C1-6 non-string test must fail. For each, the report names the file:line injected, the command `dotnet test C:/dm-wt/20261111-1831-floor-drag-placeholder/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~FloorDropIndicatorTests|FullyQualifiedName~FloorReorderDropTests"` run once per injection, the failing test names it printed, and the revert.

C1-10 (scoped build and test). `dotnet build C:/dm-wt/20261111-1831-floor-drag-placeholder/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj` ends with summary lines `0 Warning(s)` and `0 Error(s)`, quoted verbatim in the report (not established by grepping for 'warning'); `dotnet test C:/dm-wt/20261111-1831-floor-drag-placeholder/src/DungeonMaster.Tests/DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj --no-build` reports Failed: 0 with its Passed and Total figures quoted. No other project is built by this task.

C1-11 (stale comments, contract C1 section 4 T1 rows). `FloorReorderDrop.cs:35-39` and `MapEditorState.cs:14-15` (as numbered at 12ef199) no longer describe a placeholder: `grep -n -i placeholder src/DungeonMaster.App.Core/Editor/FloorReorderDrop.cs src/DungeonMaster.App.Core/Editor/MapEditorState.cs` prints 0 lines (2 at 12ef199: `FloorReorderDrop.cs:37`, `MapEditorState.cs:15`); control that must still match: `grep -c -i placeholder src/DungeonMaster.App.Core/Timing/OptimisticGhostSequence.cs` prints a non-zero count, unchanged from 12ef199. The rewritten sentences are true of the post-T2 design (the card and the list are the two drop targets).

C1-12 (conventions, dotnet-format.md sections 1, 4, 9, 12). Every new public type and member has XML documentation with descriptions on their own line indented two tabs after `///`, each a complete sentence; every control-flow body is braced; lambda parameters are descriptive words; test assertions use FluentAssertions `.Should()`. Evidence: the diff.

C1-13 (encoding). For each file this task creates or modifies, `grep -c '^ ' <file>` prints 0 (tab indentation; control: the same command on `src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml` prints a non-zero count), and `cat -A <file> | grep -c '\^M\$$'` equals `tr -cd '\n' < <file> | wc -c` (every line CRLF). Results per file in the report.
C1-14. No file this task writes contains `.sir/`: `grep -n '\.sir/' <each owned file>` prints 0 lines.

tasks.title: Replace the floor drag placeholder with an insertion line; never hide the dragged card; remove the placeholder machinery
acceptance: C2-1 (red step, then green; contract C1 V1, Gate 2 decision D1). Before any production file changes, `src/DungeonMaster.App.Tests/Views/FloorDragIndicatorPageTests.cs` holds a test that populates a `DungeonDetailPage` with 3 floors (the in-host shape of `DungeonDetailPageFloorListTests.PopulatedPage`), invokes the second row's `OnDragStarting` by reflection, and asserts the second row's `Opacity` is 0.4 and the first and third rows' `Opacity` is 1. Run at this task's startRef with `dotnet build C:/dm-wt/20261111-1831-floor-drag-placeholder/src/DungeonMaster.App.Tests/DungeonMaster.App.Tests.csproj` then `dotnet test C:/dm-wt/20261111-1831-floor-drag-placeholder/src/DungeonMaster.App.Tests/DungeonMaster.App.Tests.csproj --no-build --filter FullyQualifiedName~FloorDragIndicatorPageTests`, it must fail (at 12ef199 `OnFloorDragStarted` sets `item.Opacity = 0`, `DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs:982`); the report quotes the failure, and the same command passes after the change. Structural proxy for contract C1 V1; it does not close Gate 3 check H1.

C2-2 (red step, then green). A test in the same file invokes the second row's `OnDragStarting`, then the third row's `OnDragOver` with a `DragEventArgs` built from that drag's data, and asserts `FloorListContainer.Children` holds the same instances in the same order as before the drag. It must fail at this task's startRef (at 12ef199 `ShowDragPlaceholder` inserts a Border, `DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs:2658`) and pass after, with the failure quoted from the C2-1 command.

C2-3 (red step, then green). A test in the same file runs a self-drop: the second row's `OnDragStarting`, `OnDragOver` and `OnDrop` on that same row, with no `DropCompleted`, then asserts every row has `Opacity` 1 and `FloorListContainer.Children` is unchanged. It must fail at this task's startRef (the dragged row is left at 0 there) and pass after, with the failure quoted from the C2-1 command. Structural proxy only; Gate 3 H1 is the real check.

C2-4 (injection; contract C1 V6). A test invokes the second row's `OnDragStarting`, sets `FloorDropIndicatorLine.Opacity` to 1, invokes the page's `OnFloorListDrop` with a `DropEventArgs` that carries no position, then asserts the line's `Opacity` is 0 and every row's `Opacity` is 1 (the null-position return). Demonstrated by deleting the teardown call on that return path (one named file:line), running the C2-1 command, quoting the failure, reverting, and verifying the revert.

C2-5 (injection; contract C1 V1 and V6, drag-start reset). A test sets `FloorDropIndicatorLine.Opacity` to 1 and the first row's `Opacity` to 0.4 (left by a lost drag), invokes the second row's `OnDragStarting`, and asserts the line's `Opacity` is 0, the first row's is 1 and the second row's is 0.4. Demonstrated by injection at one named site exactly as in C2-4.

C2-6 (injection; contract C1 V6, card `DropReceived`). A test invokes the second row's `OnDragStarting`, sets `FloorDropIndicatorLine.Opacity` to 1, invokes the third row's `OnDrop` with a payload that `FloorReorderDrop.Decide` declines (no `FloorId` key), and asserts the line's `Opacity` is 0 and every row's `Opacity` is 1. Demonstrated by injection at one named site exactly as in C2-4.

C2-7 (census, contract C1 V2). `grep -n -E 'FloorListContainer(\.Children)?\.(Add|Insert|Remove|RemoveAt|Clear)\(' src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs` prints 0 lines. At 12ef199 it prints 3 (`:2594`, `:2658`, `:2670`); must-match case `FloorListContainer.Children.Insert(insertIdx, _dragPlaceholder);` (`:2658`); near-miss that must not match `MapOverlay.Children.Add(palette);` (`:1338`).

C2-8 (census, contract C1 V1, Gate 2 decision D1). The page declares the dim value once: `grep -c 'const double DraggedFloorCardOpacity = 0.4;' src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs` prints 1 (0 at 12ef199). Every other Opacity write on a floor row is a reset to full opacity: `grep -n -E '\.Opacity *=' src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs | grep -v '///' | grep -v -E 'MapToolbar\.Opacity|UndoButton\.Opacity|FloorDropIndicatorLine\.Opacity'` prints exactly 2 lines, one assigning `DraggedFloorCardOpacity` and one assigning `1` or `1.0` (2 at 12ef199, but assigning `0` at `:982` and `1.0` at `:991`; the must-match case is a line assigning `DraggedFloorCardOpacity`, the near-miss that must not appear is `item.Opacity = 0;`). The doc line `:1358` ('Opacity rather than <c>IsVisible</c>') must not match the first grep. No drag handler writes `IsVisible` on a floor row. `grep -c -E 'Opacity *=' src/DungeonMaster.App/Controls/FloorSidebarItem/FloorSidebarItem.xaml.cs` prints 0, as at 12ef199 (preserved).

C2-9 (census, contract C1 V2). `grep -n -E '_dragPlaceholder|_draggingItem|_currentPlaceholderTarget|_placeholderAfterTarget|ShowDragPlaceholder|ClearDragPlaceholder|OnFloorPlaceholderRequested|OnFloorPlaceholderCleared|PlaceholderRequested|PlaceholderCleared' src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml src/DungeonMaster.App/Controls/FloorSidebarItem/FloorSidebarItem.xaml.cs` prints 0 lines (38 at 12ef199, counted with `| wc -l`).

C2-10 (contract C1 V3, placement). `grep -c 'x:Name="FloorDropIndicatorLine"' src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml` prints 1 (0 at 12ef199). The element is a `BoxView` that is a sibling of `FloorListContainer` inside a `Grid` forming the `ScrollView`'s content (the ScrollView at `DungeonDetailPage.xaml:692`), declared after `FloorListContainer` and never added to it. Evidence: the diff.

C2-11 (contract C1 V3, inertness). In XAML the `FloorDropIndicatorLine` declares `InputTransparent="True"`, `Opacity="0"`, `HeightRequest="2"`, `VerticalOptions="Start"` and the colour token `DmDragPlaceholderStroke`. Evidence: the diff.

C2-12 (contract C1 V3, inset). The line's right inset is taken from `FloorListContainer`'s `Padding`, by a XAML binding or a constructor-time read, and the diff adds no literal `14` for it. Evidence: the diff.

C2-13 (contract C1 V3, no relayout mid-drag). Every assignment to a `FloorDropIndicatorLine` property in `DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs` outside the page constructor targets `TranslationY` or `Opacity`: `grep -n -o -E 'FloorDropIndicatorLine\.[A-Za-z]+ *=' src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs` lists no other property except at most one constructor-time inset assignment, which the report names.

C2-14 (contract C1 V4, one band builder). `grep -c 'new FloorListBand(' src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs` prints 1, and the method containing it is called from exactly two sites: `OnFloorListDrop` and the indicator show method. Evidence: the command and the diff (the count is 1 at 12ef199 too, inside `OnFloorListDrop`; the new fact is the second caller).

C2-15 (contract C1 V5, show path). The show method obtains the dragged id only through `FloorReorderDrop.TryReadDraggedFloorId` and the landing only through `FloorDropIndicator.Locate`: `grep 'TryReadDraggedFloorId(' src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs | grep -v '///' | wc -l` and `grep 'FloorDropIndicator.Locate(' src/DungeonMaster.App/Views/DungeonDetailPage/DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs | grep -v '///' | wc -l` each print 1 (0 at 12ef199; Gate 2 decision D3: documentation lines are not counted). The card's new `DragOverReceived` event and the list's `OnFloorListDragOver` both route to that method. Evidence: the commands and the diff.

C2-16 (contract C1 V5, card events). `FloorSidebarItem.xaml.cs` declares `public event EventHandler<DragEventArgs>? DragOverReceived` raised from `OnDragOver`, and `public event EventHandler? DropReceived` raised as the first statement of `OnDrop`, before `FloorReorderDrop.Decide`; both carry XML documentation; the template in `DungeonDetailPage.xaml` wires both. Evidence: the diff.

C2-17 (contract C1 V6). `DungeonDetailPage.xaml`'s `FloorListContainer` `DropGestureRecognizer` declares `DragLeave="OnFloorListDragLeave"`, and that handler hides the line only when the position is null or outside `[0, Width) x [0, Height)` of `FloorListContainer`. Evidence: the diff.

C2-18 (contract C1 V6). Every return path of `OnFloorListDrop` hides the line: the null-position return, the `Owner != FloorList` return, the `ShouldReorder == false` return and the reorder path. Evidence: the diff.

C2-19 (contract C1 V8; preserved shape, newly narrowed). `grep -rn TransientDropTarget src --include=*.cs --exclude-dir=obj --exclude-dir=bin` prints 0 lines (4 at 12ef199: `FloorReorderNearest.cs:20`, `DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs:2478`, `FloorDragHandleDropTargetTests.cs:160`, `:240`). The only test removals in this task are the method `ThePlaceholderIsLandedInButNeverResolvedTo` and the placeholder-only assertion at `FloorDragHandleDropTargetTests.cs:239-244`: `grep -c -E '^[[:space:]]*\[(Fact|Theory)' src/DungeonMaster.Tests/App/Layout/FloorDragHandleDropTargetTests.cs` goes from 6 to 5, and no other test in the solution is deleted or weakened.

C2-20 (stale comments, contract C1 section 4 T2 rows). Each listed range (`DungeonDetailPage.xaml:686-691`, `:700-724`, `:731-739`; `DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs:46-47`, `:2422-2425`, `:2440-2446`, `:2448-2451`, `:2487-2489`, `:2499-2501`; `FloorSidebarItem.xaml.cs:130-138`, `:508-515`, `:524-525`; `FloorReorderNearest.cs:14-20`, `:115-123`, `:178-179`; `FloorDragHandleTests.cs:252-255`; `FloorDragHandleDropTargetTests.cs:56`, `:145-186`, `:239-244`, numbered at 12ef199) is rewritten or removed so that every sentence is true of the post-change code, and the report names each range's new location. Evidence: the diff.

C2-21 (stale-comment census). `grep -n -i placeholder <file> | grep -v DmDragPlaceholder` prints 0 lines for each of `DungeonDetailPage.xaml`, `FloorSidebarItem.xaml.cs`, `FloorReorderNearest.cs`, `FloorDragHandleTests.cs` and `FloorDragHandleDropTargetTests.cs`, and for `DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs` prints exactly the 2 map lines contract C1 section 4 keeps ('paints placeholders', 'renders the placeholder'; `:376`, `:606` at 12ef199). Control that must still match: `grep -c -i placeholder src/DungeonMaster.App/Controls/FloorSidebarItem/FloorSidebarItem.xaml` prints 1, unchanged. `grep -n -i -E 'third drop target|other two drop' <the six files of C2-20>` prints 0 lines (6 at 12ef199: `DungeonDetailPage.xaml:700`, `DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs:2423`, `:2450`, `:2499`, `FloorReorderNearest.cs:117`, `FloorDragHandleDropTargetTests.cs:56`).

C2-22 (contract C1 V7, preserved). The drop meaning is unchanged: `FloorReorderDropRoundTripTests`, `FloorReorderCommandArgsTests`, the remaining `FloorDragHandleDropTargetTests` and `AsyncVoidUnitsAreGuardedTests` pass unmodified in the C2-24 run, and the T1 agreement test (`FloorDropIndicatorTests`, C1-4) is the new instrument tying the indicator to the same resolver.

C2-23 (repo-wide build; last task in the chain). `dotnet build C:/dm-wt/20261111-1831-floor-drag-placeholder/src/DungeonMaster.sln` ends with `0 Warning(s)` and `0 Error(s)`, the two summary lines quoted verbatim in the report (never established by grepping for 'warning').

C2-24 (repo-wide test). `dotnet test C:/dm-wt/20261111-1831-floor-drag-placeholder/src/DungeonMaster.sln --no-build` reports Failed: 0 for each of its three test assemblies (DungeonMaster.Tests, DungeonMaster.App.Tests, DungeonMaster.App.UnitTests; the solution's 8 projects at 12ef199, `grep -c 'Project(' src/DungeonMaster.sln`, include no other test project), and the report quotes each assembly's Passed and Total. DungeonMaster.Tests' Total equals the base total from the orchestrator's 12ef199 probe (as quoted in spec.md's Assumptions) plus T1's added cases minus the cases of the deleted test, and App.Tests' Total equals its base plus this task's new cases, each difference stated.

C2-25 (encoding). Each `.cs` file this task creates or modifies prints 0 for `grep -c '^ ' <file>`; `DungeonDetailPage.xaml` keeps its existing space indentation; and for every owned file `cat -A <file> | grep -c '\^M\$$'` equals `tr -cd '\n' < <file> | wc -c`. Results per file in the report.

C2-26 (conventions, dotnet-format.md sections 1, 4, 9, 12). New and changed members carry XML documentation in the two-tab form, braces on every control-flow body, descriptive lambda names; new test methods state condition and outcome in their names. Evidence: the diff.
C2-27. No file this task writes contains `.sir/`: `grep -n '\.sir/' <each owned file>` prints 0 lines; and no comment it writes cites a `.sir/backlog.md` line number.

C2-28 (contract C1 V1 and V5, Gate 2 decision D1). The full-opacity reset sets `Opacity` to 1 on every `FloorSidebarItem` child of `FloorListContainer` by walking the children, not through a stored reference to the dragged row (C2-9 forbids `_draggingItem`). It runs on source `DragStarted` before the dim, on source `DragEnded`, on card `DropReceived`, and on every return path of `OnFloorListDrop`, and it does NOT run on `OnFloorListDragLeave` (the drag continues there). Evidence: the diff and the tests of C2-3 to C2-6.
